svg.title: Ecologist — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as ecologist, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A magnifying lens surrounds a six-legged field insect above a separate small leaf specimen. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
